title: Twisted long code
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and assign to each vertex a function from the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs. For a vertex $v$, a neighbor $w$ of $v$, and a query $x$, the twisted long code is the real value of the sign returned by $w$'s function at the query obtained by permuting $x$ according to the constraint on $(v,w)$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game G with alphabet size q
A Boolean sign-valued function at each vertex
A query x in the q-dimensional Boolean cube
